statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, writing r also for its mathematical integer value, r = (sum over i with 1 <= i <= n and m not dividing i of i) - (sum over i with 1 <= i <= n and m dividing i of i). Here 'm dividing i' means i = m*q for some integer q.
preconditions: n and m are 64-bit signed integers whose mathematical integer values satisfy 1 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= m <= 1000.

statement: For every n and m satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result; it does not fail, panic, or overflow.
preconditions: n and m are 64-bit signed integers whose mathematical integer values satisfy 1 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= m <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns r, |r| <= n*(n+1)/2.
preconditions: n and m are 64-bit signed integers whose mathematical integer values satisfy 1 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= m <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns r, r and n*(n+1)/2 have the same parity; equivalently, r - n*(n+1)/2 is even.
preconditions: n and m are 64-bit signed integers whose mathematical integer values satisfy 1 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= m <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns r, letting q = floor(n/m) be the greatest integer q such that q*m <= n, we have r = n*(n+1)/2 - m*q*(q+1).
preconditions: n and m are 64-bit signed integers whose mathematical integer values satisfy 1 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= m <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns r, let N = sum over i with 1 <= i <= n and m not dividing i of i and D = sum over i with 1 <= i <= n and m dividing i of i. Then N + D = n*(n+1)/2 and N - D = r.
preconditions: n and m are 64-bit signed integers whose mathematical integer values satisfy 1 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= m <= 1000.

statement: For every n and m satisfying the preconditions, if m <= n, then whenever the function returns r, r <= n*(n+1)/2 - 2*m.
preconditions: n and m are 64-bit signed integers whose mathematical integer values satisfy 1 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= m <= 1000.

statement: For every n and m satisfying the preconditions, if m > 1, then whenever the function returns r, r >= 2 - n*(n+1)/2.
preconditions: n and m are 64-bit signed integers whose mathematical integer values satisfy 1 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= m <= 1000.
